name: Morikubo Naraku
source:
"Hey there... I'm Naraku Morikubo. I used to be... well, Hinata's idol. What I am now... not even I care to know."

Another of [url=/c160583]ARATA's[/url] hastily created Ludens. She was created based off a recent deceased idol and her memories of her past. Though the body was supposedly in pieces... perhaps Eni helped reconstruct it.

Naraku is cold, blunt, and sharp-tongued. She harbors overwhelming sadness deep inside. The brightness from her idol days is completely gone. You'd think after coming back to life, she could be a bit more cheerful.

Fascinated by analyzing the logic behind tragic deaths, she supports ARATA's rampage. Her motives make her a terrifying foe for [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url].

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category9&ch=naraku]official website[/url]]
